stem: How did the gift of a baseball affect the author?

options.label: A
options.text: It motivated him to create a game that did not require sight.

options.label: B
options.text: It reminded him of the fun activities that he could no longer enjoy.

options.label: C
options.text: It reinforced his belief that people are often thoughtless.

options.label: D
options.text: It offered him the chance to try playing a traditional game.
